verses.text: Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, That walketh in his ways.

segments.text: Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah,

verses.text: For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands: Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

segments.text: For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands:
Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

verses.text: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, Round about thy table.

segments.text: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine,
In the innermost parts of thy house;

verses.text: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed That feareth Jehovah.

segments.text: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed

verses.text: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion: And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

segments.text: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion:
And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

verses.text: Yea, see thou thy children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

segments.text: Yea, see thou thy children’s children.
